summary: Russian forces captured Kiyanitsa in Sumy region and advanced 300 meters while a massive drone wave struck Kyiv, Chernihiv, Dnipro, and other regions causing widespread infrastructure damage. Ukrainian pilots will begin Rafale training in France in November 2026. Russian drone attacks also hit the Moscow region and damaged a Yandex data center.
key_points: Russian "North" grouping seized Kiyanitsa in Sumy region and advanced 300 meters amid heavy fighting north of Sumy. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

Massive drone attack across Ukraine: Geran-5 struck Bucha, Hostomel, Chernihiv; jet Shaheds targeted Kyiv, Dnipro, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Cherkasy regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76422, @mon1tor_ua/76390, @mon1tor_ua/76421, @mon1tor_ua/76408)
Russian strikes on Kyiv energy infrastructure October 8 caused citywide power outages, metro shutdown, water supply disruptions in five districts. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)
Ukrainian pilots to begin Rafale training in France November 2026; first 16 aircraft with AASM, MICA, Meteor missiles expected 2028-2029. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23891)
Drone attack on Moscow region (Podolsk) killed one civilian; Putin's presidential aircraft circled Moscow due to drone threat. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847, @UkraineNow/84572)
Yandex data center damaged by UAV attack; Zelensky confirmed strike, damage assessment ongoing. (Source: @UkraineNow/84556)

In Zaporizhzhia direction, Russian Transbaikal and Buryatia units advanced west of Zorevka and northwest of Zarnitsa; Sakhalin units captured strongholds west of Novosoloshino. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)
Sabotage in Rivne: 14-year-old girl strangled Ukrainian soldier on Russian special services' orders via video call. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33859)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces captured the village of Kiyanitsa in Sumy region and advanced 300 meters, marking a notable tactical gain on the northern flank. Simultaneously, a massive wave of jet-powered Shahed and Geran-5 drones struck multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Chernihiv, and Dnipropetrovsk, causing widespread power outages, metro shutdowns, and water supply disruptions in the capital. Ukrainian pilots are scheduled to begin Rafale fighter training in France in November 2026, signaling a long-term enhancement of air capabilities.

points: Kyiv suffered widespread power outages after Russian strikes on energy infrastructure on October 8; all three metro lines, trams, trolleybuses, and the funicular were shut down, and water supply disruptions affected Sviatoshynskyi, Solomianskyi, Shevchenkivskyi, Holosiivskyi, and Pecherskyi districts; sewage pumping stations stopped working, temporarily suspending wastewater acceptance. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

Mayor Vitali Klitschko stated Kyiv is fully prepared for the heating season; combined heat and power plants are reportedly ready for operation, and specific components have been additionally protected against potential attacks. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33860)

Ukrainian pilots will begin training on Rafale fighters in France in November 2026; Ukraine ordered 16 Rafale jets with AASM bombs, MICA and Meteor missiles, and laser-guided anti-drone rockets; first deliveries expected 2028-2029. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23891)

In Rivne, a 14-year-old girl strangled a 27-year-old Ukrainian soldier on orders from Russian special services; she spiked his alcohol with methadone and killed him during a video call with her Russian handler; she faces up to 15 years in prison. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33859)

A Territorial Recruitment Center officer in Kharkiv pushed a 74-year-old woman, causing femoral neck and collarbone fractures; officers did not provide assistance or call an ambulance but drove away immediately. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33846)

Ukraine will not agree to EU membership subject to permanent restrictions on grain exports, Agriculture Minister Vysotskyi stated; Kiev is open to temporary quotas and transitional periods with a defined end date. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33839)

Russian Yandex data center was damaged by a UAV attack; Zelensky confirmed the strike; Yandex stated the scale of damage is still being assessed and it is unknown if operations can be restored. (Source: @UkraineNow/84556)

Russian "North" grouping of forces took control of the village of Kiyanitsa in the Sumy region and advanced assault units by 300 meters in the area; heavy fighting continues north of Sumy. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

Russian aviation and Geran drones struck UAV assembly and storage facilities near Kovchin in Chernihiv region, as well as positions of the 105th Border Guard Detachment and the 143rd Separate Mechanized Brigade near Sutki and Semyonovka; a command post of the 18th Army Corps near Bahmachi was also hit. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)
A drone attack in the Klymovsk microdistrict of Podolsk, Moscow region, killed a 57-year-old man and injured another person on October 8. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

In Belgorod region on October 8: a man was killed in Grayvoron by a drone explosion, three injured; in Oktyabrskoye an FPV drone attacked a car injuring a woman; in Politotdel'skoye a woman was injured by a drone detonation; in Shebekino another person was injured when a drone was shot down. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)
In Kursk region, an enemy drone attacked a private house in the village of Ilek in Belovsky district, killing a 53-year-old man. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

Russian diplomats will investigate the detention of the head of the Telegram channel "Rybar" Zvinchuk in Montenegro and protect his rights, Kremlin spokesman Peskov stated. (Source: @tass_agency/399509)
In the Krasnolymansky direction, fighting continues for forest areas and settlements on the approaches to Krasny Lyman. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

In the Kupyansk direction, clashes continue for positions and communication lines along the Oskil River; Russian units continue offensive operations on the eastern and northern approaches to Kupyansk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

In the Druzhkovka direction, Russian units continue offensive operations; military sources report fighting on the approaches to the agglomeration and in the area of Dobropolye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

In the Sumy direction, heavy fighting continues north of Sumy; the "Pivnich" Task Force reported the advance of assault units in the area of Kiyanitsa by 300 meters, and in the Shostkinsky district, the advance of forces near Koryenka; Russian aviation, artillery, and UAV units struck in the areas of Sumy, Boyaro-Lezhachaya, Stetskovka, Osoevka, and Turya. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

In the Chernihiv region, the "Pivnich" Task Force reported strikes by aviation and Geran drones on UAV assembly and storage facilities near Kovchin, positions of the 105th Border Guard Detachment and the 143rd Separate Mechanized Brigade near Sutki and Semyonovka, and a command post of the 18th Army Corps near Bahmachi. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

In the Kharkiv direction, fighting continues in the Liptsivske, Volchanske, and Velikoburlukske areas; the "Pivnich" Task Force reported the advance of assault units in the area of Tokarevka; in the northeast of the Kharkiv region, the task force reported continued fighting with encircled units of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

Multiple jet-powered Shahed drones were tracked moving from Belarus into northern Zhytomyr region, from northern Chernihiv region toward Kyiv (Vyshhorod district), and from Kyiv region toward Zhytomyr (Korosten district) and Chernihiv regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76408, @mon1tor_ua/76414, @kpszsu/84378)

In the Zaporizhzhia direction, the "Skhid" Task Force reports the continuation of offensives in several areas; 13 enemy counterattacks were thwarted in a single day; Transbaikal units advanced west of Zorevka, Buryatia units are penetrating defenses northwest of Zarnitsa, and Sakhalin units captured fortified strongholds west of Novosoloshino. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

In the Kherson direction, there is high activity of artillery and drones on both banks of the Dnipro River; in Aleshki and other frontline settlements on the left bank, strikes by FPV drones and remote mining of roads continue to complicate civilian transport and delivery of goods. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)
Jet-powered UAVs were observed past Mykolaiv heading north, and over Dnipropetrovsk region heading toward Petropavlivka. (Source: @kpszsu/84372, @kpszsu/84383)

A massive drone wave on October 9 included Geran-5 strikes on Bucha, Hostomel, and Chernihiv; jet-powered Shaheds targeted Kyiv, Dnipro, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Cherkasy, and Chernihiv regions; air alert in Kyiv lasted from 12:10 to 14:21. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76422, @mon1tor_ua/76390, @mon1tor_ua/76421, @mon1tor_ua/76408, @eRadarrua/121406, @eRadarrua/121423)

Russian drone attack on Moscow region (Podolsk) killed one civilian; four presidential aircraft circled Moscow unable to land due to drone threat, two possibly diverted to St. Petersburg; unknown if Putin was aboard. (Source: @UkraineNow/84572, @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)
